title: Die Ausrede 🍓🧅
caption: Folge 3: Gino erfindet Jürgen als neuen Trainer … und Avo muss die Rolle übernehmen. 😅 Folge mir für Teil 4!

scenes.p: a cartoon garlic vegetable mascot: its whole body is one big white garlic bulb with thick cartoon eyebrows, short muscular stubby cartoon arms and legs, wearing a tiny grey sweatband, the character is literally a walking garlic bulb, no face, no skin, no hair, no neck, toy-like mascot, standing in the gym hallway, arms crossed, nervous

lines.t: Ein neuer Trainer, ich brauche Hilfe.

scenes.p: a cartoon avocado vegetable mascot: its whole body is one big green avocado cut in half with a round brown pit in the belly, short stubby cartoon arms and legs, wearing a small green scarf, the character is literally a walking avocado, no face, no skin, no hair, no neck, toy-like mascot, wearing a fake beard, holding a clipboard

lines.t: Ja klar. Und ich bin eine Banane.
Guten Morgen, ich bin Jürgen, euer neuer Fitnesscoach, bereit zu motivieren!
Perfekt, Jürgen, du übernimmst das Krafttraining heute.

scenes.p: a round red onion vegetable plush toy: the whole character is ONE red onion bulb (dark red-violet onion skin with thin pale stripes), no hair, the top of the onion tapers into a small dried brown sprout, two big cartoon eyes and a small smile on the onion, tiny stubby green arms and legs, holding a tiny wooden spoon, the character is literally a walking red onion, not a person, standing in a cozy kitchen, plush toy look

lines.t: Dann lade Jürgen zum Essen ein.

scenes.p: a cartoon avocado vegetable mascot: its whole body is one big green avocado cut in half with a round brown pit in the belly, short stubby cartoon arms and legs, wearing a small green scarf, the character is literally a walking avocado, no face, no skin, no hair, no neck, toy-like mascot, gesturing enthusiastically

lines.t: Du bist hier zum Reden, nicht Schwitzen!
Beruhigt euch, das ist nur eine Ausrede.

scenes.p: a cartoon strawberry fruit mascot: its whole body is one big shiny red strawberry with yellow seeds and a green leaf crown, short stubby cartoon arms and legs, wearing a tiny pink sweatband, the character is literally a walking strawberry, no face, no skin, no hair, no neck, toy-like mascot, entering the gym, eyes wide

lines.t: Ich sehe einen Avocado mit Bart, ist das unser Trainer?
